title: Chronic Pain Self-management Support With Pain Education and Exercise
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the combination of self-management support, pain science education, and individualized, goal-oriented exercises helps people with chronic pain to increase their function.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* participants will all be adults who have been experiencing non-cancer related pain for at least 12 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* cancer related pain
* medical "red flags" suggestive of a non-neuromusculoskeletal etiology of symptoms
* casted fracture within the last 12 weeks
* related surgery within the last 26 weeks
* evidence of upper motor neuron lesion
